name: company_match_via_normalized_name_copies_facts
spec_quote: Company facts come from the companies table, matched on a normalized company name: ... So "Acme Corp." matches "ACME, Inc." Fields copied when missing: sponsorship, h1b_fy25, h1b_total, h1b_since, gc_sponsor, gc_perm, gc_months, referral, contacts, warm_path.

name: company_match_does_not_overwrite_present_fields
spec_quote: Never overwrite. A field that is present with a value (including 0, "", "No", False) is kept as it is. ... Fields copied when missing: sponsorship, h1b_fy25, ...

name: company_match_ampersand_and_stopwords
spec_quote: lowercase, "&" → " and ", .com dropped, non-alphanumerics → space, the words inc, incorporated, llc, corp, corporation, co, company, ... removed, spaces collapsed.

name: company_match_dotcom_dropped_and_inc_removed
spec_quote: .com dropped, non-alphanumerics → space, the words inc, incorporated, llc, corp, corporation, co, company, ltd, ... removed, spaces collapsed.

name: company_no_match_uses_defaults
spec_quote: No match → sponsorship "Unknown — verify", h1b_fy25 0, h1b_total 0, h1b_since "", gc_sponsor "", gc_perm "", gc_months "", referral "Cold", contacts "", warm_path "".

name: matched_company_null_field_uses_default
spec_quote: A matched company whose own field is null/absent gives that same default.

name: referral_detail_from_present_referral_and_li_defaults
spec_quote: referral_detail (if missing) = the final `referral` value. li_connections and li_alumni (if missing) = 0.

name: referral_detail_from_company_derived_referral
spec_quote: Fields copied when missing: ... referral ... referral_detail (if missing) = the final `referral` value.

name: remote_yes_case_insensitive_location

spec_quote: remote (if missing) = "Yes" when the location contains the word "remote" (any case), else "No". salary (if missing) = "". posted (if missing) = "".

name: track_ai_for_ml_title
spec_quote: track (if missing or null) = from the title, first match wins, case-insensitive whole words: AI words (ai, machine learning, ml, llm, genai, generative, agent, agentic, nlp, deep learning, computer vision, research engineer, mlops…) → "AI Agentic Eng";

name: track_data_engineer_beats_analytics

name: track_data_analyst_with_null_track

name: track_product_manager

name: track_data_sci_analytics

name: track_other_when_nothing_matches

name: track_present_other_is_kept

name: other_fields_not_added_or_changed
